objective: Test a zero-parameter evidence-dominance arbitration rule on a completely untouched external cohort. The rule must improve time-stable probability quality without using the consumed 2019-2022 Big-5 folds or the first external stress cohort to set any numeric model threshold.

data.cohort_guard: NONE of E1,D2,I2,SP2,F2 in 2024/25 or 2025/26 may have appeared in the first external stress cohort N1,P1,B1,SC0,T1,G1.

mechanism.baseline_probability: normalize reciprocal opening average odds AvgH/AvgD/AvgA
mechanism.signal_probability: normalize reciprocal closing average odds AvgCH/AvgCD/AvgCA
mechanism.evidence_dominance_rule: For a raw proposal old->target, execute only if log(Pclose[target]/Pclose[old]) >= log(Popen[old]/Popen[target]). This is an exact zero-threshold comparison of reversal evidence against the opening preference it overturns; no fitted scalar, grid, TV cutoff, league exception, team exception or fold exception is permitted.
mechanism.weak_side: argmin of opening home-vs-away probability only; draw is never weak side
mechanism.weak_floor: P_weak_after >= P_weak_before; otherwise exact opening-probability fallback

comparators.always_project: first external-stress operator: whenever closing Top1 differs, apply exact V3.2.4 projection
comparators.evidence_dominance: apply exact V3.2.4 projection only when the frozen log-evidence dominance inequality holds

evaluation.fold_construction: sort all completed usable rows by match date then deterministic league/home/away tie-break; split into 12 contiguous equal-count folds before metric evaluation

interpretation_guards: This is not a Big-5 V3.2.4 out-of-domain model evaluation.
Closing odds are not added to any football3 production or research model.
This experiment only tests whether a zero-parameter arbitration principle improves the stability of the same frozen projection operator under a second independent pre-match signal cohort.
No result can promote Formal V2, V3.1.1, V3.2.4 or Stage7.
If this cohort fails, no rescue threshold may be derived from these labels.
If this cohort passes, the rule may be considered a pre-frozen arbitration hypothesis for a future genuinely fresh Big-5 confirmation, not retroactively applied to consumed 2019-2022 labels.
